facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores reports that the electronic vaccination register and the medicines and supplies management system are integrated with or interoperable with DHIS2, as presented at a 27 October 2026 coordination meeting.

COM.note: The article does not say DHIS2 is national with facilities across the country reporting, nor give a reporting rate.
